about.title: About
about.description: A tweaking, cleanup and diagnostics tool for Windows 10/11.
elevation.title: Administrator rights required
elevation.body:
The program changes system settings and must run as administrator.

Restart with administrator rights?
elevation.failed: Could not restart with administrator rights. Close the program and start it manually: right-click the file → “Run as administrator”.
elevation.declined: The program was closed: without administrator rights system changes are not possible.
instance.title: WinTweaker is already running
instance.body: The window is already open. Close it before starting a second copy: two copies can interfere with each other when reverting changes.

tweak.PRIV-01.title: Advertising ID and ads
tweak.PRIV-01.description: Turns off the advertising ID and ads in the system.
tweak.PRIV-02.title: Windows settings sync
tweak.PRIV-02.description: Turns off syncing settings between devices.
tweak.PRIV-06.title: Application inventory
tweak.PRIV-06.description: Turns off inventory collection of installed applications.
tweak.PRIV-07.title: Application usage statistics
tweak.PRIV-07.description: Reduces telemetry and program usage tracking.
tweak.PRIV-08.title: Handwriting input
tweak.PRIV-08.description: Turns off handwriting data collection and error reports.
tweak.PRIV-09.title: Telemetry network domains
tweak.PRIV-09.description: Adds a managed telemetry domain block to hosts.
tweak.PRIV-10.title: User behaviour recording
tweak.PRIV-10.description: Turns off behaviour recording and the lock screen camera.
tweak.PRIV-11.title: Location
tweak.PRIV-11.description: Turns off location and its use by scripts.
tweak.PRIV-12.title: Feedback (SIUF)
tweak.PRIV-12.description: Turns off feedback collection and notifications.
tweak.PRIV-13.title: Speech model updates
tweak.PRIV-15.title: Microsoft experiments
tweak.PRIV-15.description: Turns off Microsoft experiments on the device.
tweak.PRIV-03.title: Windows and Office telemetry
tweak.PRIV-03.description: Disables telemetry services, the autologger and Office tasks.
tweak.PRIV-04.title: NVIDIA telemetry
tweak.PRIV-04.description: Stops the NVIDIA service and disables its tasks.
tweak.PRIV-05.title: Data collection through the scheduler
tweak.PRIV-05.description: Disables Windows tasks that collect diagnostics.
tweak.PRIV-14.title: System monitoring (CDP)
tweak.PRIV-14.description: Disables the CDP service and the Task View button.
tweak.PRIV-16.title: Diagnostic services
tweak.PRIV-16.description: Stops and disables DiagTrack and dmwappushservice without deleting them.
tweak.PRIV-17.title: Diagnostic event log
tweak.SVC-01.title: IPsec Policy Agent
tweak.SVC-01.description: Stops PolicyAgent and disables its startup. Required for IPsec policies; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-02.title: IPsec Key Modules
tweak.SVC-02.description: Stops IKEEXT and disables its startup. Required for IPsec connections; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-03.title: Diagnostic Service Host
tweak.SVC-03.description: Stops WdiServiceHost and disables its startup. The service collects diagnostics; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-04.title: Diagnostic System Host
tweak.SVC-04.description: Stops WdiSystemHost and disables its startup. The service is used for system diagnostics; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-05.title: Security Center
tweak.SVC-05.description: Stops wscsvc and disables its startup. Windows Security Center will not work; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-06.title: Windows Defender Center
tweak.SVC-06.description: Stops SecurityHealthService and disables its startup. This lowers system protection; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-07.title: Themes
tweak.SVC-07.description: Stops Themes and disables its startup. Visual themes will stop applying; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-08.title: Font Cache
tweak.SVC-08.description: Stops FontCache and disables its startup. Fonts will be processed more slowly; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-09.title: Web Client
tweak.SVC-09.description: Stops WebClient and disables its startup. WebDAV links will stop working; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-10.title: DNS Client
tweak.SVC-10.description: Stops Dnscache and disables its startup. This can break networking; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-11.title: Server
tweak.SVC-11.description: Stops LanmanServer and disables its startup. Folder sharing will stop working; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-12.title: NetBIOS
tweak.SVC-12.description: Stops lmhosts and disables its startup. NetBIOS name resolution will stop working; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-13.title: Windows Update
tweak.SVC-13.description: Stops wuauserv and disables its startup. Windows will no longer receive updates; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-14.title: Update Orchestrator
tweak.SVC-14.description: Stops UsoSvc and disables its startup. Update scheduling will break; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-15.title: Touch Keyboard
tweak.SVC-15.description: Stops TabletInputService and disables its startup. The on-screen keyboard and handwriting may stop working; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-16.title: WMI Performance Adapter
tweak.SVC-16.description: Stops wmiApSrv and disables its startup. Some performance counters will be unavailable; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-17.title: Error Reporting
tweak.SVC-17.description: Stops WerSvc and disables its startup. Crash reports will no longer be created; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-18.title: System Events
tweak.SVC-18.description: Stops SENS and disables its startup. Programs will stop receiving system notifications; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-19.title: Windows Search
tweak.SVC-19.description: Stops WSearch and disables its startup. File and Start menu search will be slower; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-20.title: Superfetch
tweak.SVC-20.description: Stops SysMain and disables its startup. Caching of frequently used programs turns off; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-21.title: Print Spooler
tweak.SVC-21.description: Stops Spooler and disables its startup. Printing will be unavailable; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-22.title: Image Service
tweak.SVC-22.description: Stops stisvc and disables its startup. Scanners and cameras may stop working; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-23.title: Sensor Services
tweak.SVC-23.description: Stops SensorService, SensorDataService and SensrSvc and disables their startup. Sensors and auto brightness may stop working; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.SVC-24.title: Location
tweak.SVC-24.description: Stops lfsvc and disables its startup. Location detection will stop working; reverting restores the previous state.
tweak.UI-01.title: Tooltip color
tweak.UI-01.description: Sets the tooltip background to pale blue, as in classic Windows.
tweak.UI-02.title: Classic fonts
tweak.UI-02.description: Turns on standard font smoothing and substitutes classic fonts (MS Sans Serif, Tahoma) for Segoe UI.
tweak.UI-03.title: Smaller title buttons
tweak.UI-03.description: Makes the window title buttons smaller (value -270).
tweak.UI-04.title: Remove 3D Objects
tweak.UI-04.description: Removes the 3D Objects entry from This PC; the folder stays on disk.
tweak.UI-05.title: Remove folders from This PC
tweak.UI-05.description: Hides six standard folders in This PC; the folders themselves are not deleted.
tweak.UI-06.title: Remove shortcut arrows
tweak.UI-06.description: Creates a blank icon and removes the shortcut arrow overlay.
tweak.UI-07.title: Remove Shortcut to
tweak.UI-07.description: Removes the Shortcut to prefix from new shortcut names.
tweak.UI-08.title: Fast cursor blinking
tweak.UI-09.title: Fast taskbar previews
tweak.UI-09.description: Shows the window preview almost immediately on hover.
tweak.UI-10.title: Taskbar transparency
tweak.UI-11.title: Show all tray icons
tweak.UI-11.description: Shows all notification area icons and stops hiding unused ones.
tweak.UI-12.title: Explorer settings
tweak.UI-12.description: Eight values: file extensions, empty drives, merge conflicts, small taskbar icons, This PC instead of Quick Access, long paths, Notepad wrapping and status bar.
tweak.UI-13.title: Classic context menu
tweak.UI-13.description: Restores the classic Windows 10 context menu instead of the immersive one.
tweak.UI-14.title: Thin scrollbars
tweak.UI-15.title: Slow animations on Shift
tweak.UI-15.description: Slows down animations while Shift is held.
tweak.UI-16.title: This PC on the desktop
tweak.UI-16.description: Shows the This PC icon on the desktop.
tweak.UI-17.title: Restore folder windows
tweak.UI-17.description: Remembers and restores open Explorer windows after a restart.
tweak.SYS-01.title: Security Center notification
tweak.SYS-01.description: Turns off Windows Security Center notifications.
tweak.SYS-02.title: Downloaded program warning
tweak.SYS-02.description: Removes the warning for downloaded programs and the IE security settings check.
tweak.SYS-03.title: Disable Defender and SmartScreen
tweak.SYS-03.description: Disables Windows Defender, SmartScreen and related services. This lowers system protection; reverting restores the services and values.
tweak.SYS-04.title: Disable UAC
tweak.SYS-04.description: Disables User Account Control (UAC). A restart is required; reverting restores the previous values.
tweak.SYS-05.title: Ctrl+Shift layout switching
tweak.SYS-05.description: Switches layouts with Ctrl+Shift and changes the language hotkeys.
tweak.SYS-06.title: Lock screen timeout setting
tweak.SYS-06.description: Shows the lock screen display timeout setting in power options.
tweak.SYS-07.title: Memory diagnostics
tweak.SYS-07.description: Disables the Windows memory diagnostic tasks.
tweak.SYS-08.title: Teredo, ISATAP, IPv6
tweak.SYS-08.description: Disables Teredo, ISATAP, 6to4 and IPv6 anonymisation with netsh; reverting restores the defaults.
tweak.SYS-09.title: Cortana
tweak.SYS-09.description: Turns off Cortana, cloud search and contact/handwriting/typing collection.
tweak.SYS-10.title: Internet Explorer settings
tweak.SYS-10.description: Google start page and search, no IE first-run and suggestions, no active network probing.
tweak.SYS-11.title: Restart and refresh shortcuts
tweak.SYS-11.description: Creates a WinTweaker folder on the desktop with restart and shell refresh shortcuts; reverting removes the folder.
tweak.SYS-12.title: File system cache
tweak.SYS-12.description: Enables the large system cache for file operations.
tweak.SYS-13.title: Faster startup
tweak.SYS-13.description: Removes the startup delay after signing in.
tweak.SYS-14.title: Quick Access history
tweak.SYS-14.description: Turns off recent and frequent folder history in Explorer.
tweak.SYS-15.title: Emoji panel on Win+.
tweak.SYS-15.description: Enables the emoji panel on Win+period.
tweak.SYS-16.title: Restore Windows Photo Viewer
tweak.SYS-16.description: Registers Windows Photo Viewer and associates .bmp/.gif/.jpeg/.jpg/.png with it.
tweak.SYS-17.title: Remove OneDrive
tweak.SYS-17.description: Runs the OneDrive uninstaller, removes folders and the shortcut, startup entries and CLSIDs. Reverting reinstalls OneDrive; folders and data are not restored.
tweak.SYS-AZ.title: Antizapret PAC proxy
tweak.SYS-AZ.description: Enables the Antizapret PAC proxy and bypass settings. The PAC address is stored in the data and can be replaced; without network access the proxy will not work.
tweak.CTX-01.title: Take ownership and full access
tweak.CTX-01.description: Adds a file and folder menu item that takes ownership and grants full administrator access.
tweak.CTX-02.title: Useful items in the Computer menu
tweak.CTX-02.description: Adds Admin Tools, Device Manager, Services, Registry Editor, restart and shutdown to the Computer menu.
tweak.CTX-03.title: Command Prompt on the desktop menu
tweak.CTX-03.description: Adds a Command Prompt item to the desktop menu that opens in the current folder.
tweak.CTX-04.title: New items: .cmd, .reg, .vbs
tweak.CTX-04.description: Adds empty .cmd, .reg and .vbs files to the New menu.
tweak.CTX-05.title: Show or hide system folders
tweak.CTX-05.description: Adds a menu item that toggles hidden and system files.
tweak.CTX-06.title: Copy image to clipboard
tweak.CTX-06.description: Adds a copy-to-clipboard item for images.
tweak.CTX-09.title: Block or allow internet access
tweak.CTX-09.description: Adds block and allow internet menu items for .exe files using firewall rules.
tweak.CTX-10.title: Empty folder contents
tweak.CTX-10.description: Adds an empty-contents item for folders with confirmation; the folder itself stays.
tweak.CTX-11.title: Create a symbolic link
tweak.CTX-11.description: Adds a create-symbolic-link item for the desktop.
tweak.CTX-12.title: Open .nfo in Notepad
tweak.CTX-13.title: Remove Windows Media Player items
tweak.CTX-13.description: Disables the Windows Media Player Enqueue and Play items.
tweak.CTX-14.title: Remove the menu delay
tweak.CTX-14.description: Makes the context menu appear faster.
tweak.CTX-15.title: Remove extra menu items
tweak.CTX-15.description: Disables Share, Previous Versions, Pin to Start and 3D items.
tweak.CTX-16.title: Remove New menu items
tweak.CTX-16.description: Removes .bmp, .contact, .rtf, .zip and Briefcase from the New menu.
tweak.CTX-17.title: Improve the Personalize menu
tweak.CTX-17.description: Adds a Personalize submenu to the desktop menu: settings, display, sign out, restart, shutdown.
